Dial Execution: The dial has a metallic shimmer olive green finish lightly etched with circle chains that are inspired by the chin strap of a 100 year old British brass firefighter's helmet. The 3pm disc measures the start / stop chronograph hand operated by the brass chronograph buttons, and the 9pm disc is the seconds hand.
